source: 2026-11-20 synthetic dual-Qwen benchmark, expanded and QA-corrected 2026-11-23; no real Agent sessions supplied
purpose: internal routing regression and GLM candidate selection
usage_scope: internal-only routing evaluation; not a model-quality or business-accuracy benchmark
notes: v1.2.0 replaces the unreliable 17*23 QA prompt with 2+2; v1.1 calibration remains under .verification for audit.
v1.2 formal rates frozen: high 2.0, light 1.5, stable 0.75; 3.0 was overloaded.
v1.2.1 adds optional user/max_tokens/response-header capture to transport.py and documents the smoke/cold-RAG entry points; dataset, calibration, profiles and budgets are unchanged.
v1.2.2 shares scenario/window statistics, adds the client-exception regression, and uses generated cold-RAG configs; archived smoke/cold fingerprints remain unchanged.
v1.2.3 consolidates smoke/stress entries, restricts real fault cycles to .16, adds run-ID/output parameters, and archives the four analysis files under runs/*/analysis/.
v1.2.4 retires real engine stop/start; smoke uses a benchmark-only .16 TCP proxy to simulate health failure and recovery while both engines stay running.
v1.2.5 removes all executable engine stop/start entries and moves proxy health/probe helpers into transport.py; smoke uses localhost-only proxy health toggling.
v1.2.6 records the passing localhost-proxy smoke (smoke-proxy-v6) and hardens request-ID logging, encoding and unique-prefix probes.

v1.2.7 records smoke-proxy-v10 with load-steered normal/recovery probes, strict top-level failover gating (fresh summary plus child exit code), run-ID reuse rejection, confirmed proxy-stop semantics, absolute phase timestamps and 24 controlled checks.

v1.2.8 removes proxy fault from daily smoke, keeps daily stress fault-free, and adds the explicit manual .16 Qwen stop/restore drill with single/multi-cycle recovery evidence; proxy and prior real-stop archives remain historical.

v1.2.9 adds the plan follow-up: manual drill authorization from the effective Docker policy or an admin record (preflight never issues real stop/start), strict preflight refusal on unknown authorization or unreadable service state, replay-failure propagation from run_retest.py to run_stress.py with run-index and summary evidence, and the 20.00 s recovery window; dataset, calibration, profiles and budgets are unchanged.

v1.3.0 replaces drill authorization inference with a read-only preflight plus --preflight-only, removes the benchmark proxy and all no-service double tests, and keeps historical proxy/fault archives as evidence; dataset, calibration, profiles and budgets are unchanged.

v1.3.1 removes the remaining test_harness.py mock checks and the generated test-results.json, and refreshes the README, manifest and smoke source hash chain; dataset, calibration, profiles and budgets are unchanged.

v1.3.2 requires every replay round to exit 0 with a readable, positive-request result before it counts, makes preview runs non-passing, and removes the unused hot_forced.py and cold_rag/config_probe.py diagnostics; dataset, calibration, profiles and budgets are unchanged.

v1.3.3 normalizes manifest and smoke fingerprints to LF bytes so CRLF/LF checkouts validate the same, and gates smoke --baseline/--no-restart in the top-level result; dataset, calibration, profiles and budgets are unchanged.
